attackers_goals: Execute arbitrary code or load malicious DLL modules undetected within Microsoft signed program from Microsoft signed process.
description: Attackers may abuse the Odbcconf.exe Windows utility to proxy the execution of malicious DLL files.
investigative_actions: Check the execution command-line, in case of 'REGSVR' points to a DLL, then check it. If the command-line contains '/f' argument (for script file) check the content of the script.
